layer.landed_capability: Fail-closed admission boundary for a pinned Lean export of the actual mixed Section 9 stage bundle. The formal theorem selects one common physical schedule and returns smooth sums, VanishingJointJets, all three AwayExtensions, a smooth force with CandidateProperties and CandidateConsequences, derivative-H3 blow-up, all-order rapid force-jet decay, and the all-order endpoint force-jet identity. This layer does not replay Lean or materialize the missing actual stage data.
upstream_contract: identify one actual potential/direct/pressure stage bundle and one source revision
supply the genuine StageEstimates object for those exact stage families
supply shrinking-support hypotheses for the initial and every correction stage
supply one-sided extensions for every stage family at every required terminal-slice point
export the exact pinned Lean theorem application without changing field identities or schedules
formal_outputs_not_runtime_artifacts: SelectedSchedule on one common physical scale sequence
AwayExtensions for the actual A/B/P sums
all-order rapid decay of forcing jets
all-order endpoint force-jet equality to MixedPeriodicAssembly.boundaryLimits
forbidden_promotions: treating a finite endpoint ladder or max derivative order as the theorem export
using sampled, fitted, or numerical smoothness in place of all-stage one-sided extensions
cross-wiring potential, direct, or pressure stage families from different source revisions
using manufactured residual data or f=R followed by R-f=0 as independent closure
claiming runtime force, compact support, energy, or blow-up artifacts merely because the formal theorem symbol is pinned
